conventions.COLOR_0: RGBA. RGB = palette colour stored LINEAR (+0.5/255 bias, as the game). A = baked ambient occlusion (1 = open sky, 0 = fully occluded).
conventions.front: -Y Blender = +Z Godot (MODEL_FRONT), metres, origin at footprint centre z=0
conventions.materials: palette_vcol (+ window on the glass objects)
conventions.normals: custom normals exported: snow/fabric/bark smooth, hard surfaces flat faces with a 1.5-3 cm chamfer (hardened normals). Do NOT force flat normals in the shader (no dFdx/dFdy normal).
conventions.shader_hint: world_vcol.gdshader: `AO = COLOR.a; AO_LIGHT_AFFECT = 0.35;` (or ALBEDO *= mix(1.0, COLOR.a, 0.6) for a stylised darker crease look). StandardMaterial3D ignores the alpha (opaque).
